program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (15.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L_in":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid_p":  (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # PMOS mirror load / CS device
    "L_p":     (0.35, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid_n":  (11.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # NMOS current-mirror devices
    "L_n":     (0.5, 0.3, 2.0),
    "I1":      (6e-6, 3e-6, 9e-6),     # tail current
    "I2":      (7e-6, 3e-6, 10e-6),    # CS stage current
    "Wn_out":  (1.5, 0.6, 4.0),        # output inverter nfet width
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    iref = spec.get("iref", 5e-6)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    I1, I2 = p["I1"], p["I2"]

    # NMOS bias mirror: reference diode, tail, CS current source (same gm/Id, L)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], iref, vds=0.7)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], I1, vds=0.3)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], I2, vds=0.9)

    # differential pair devices
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], I1 / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.3)
    # PMOS mirror load and CS device: same density -> balanced trip point
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], I1 / 2, vds=1.0)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], I2, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # diff pair: out1 falls when vinp > vinn
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "out1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "out1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # CS stage: x rises when out1 falls
    n.dev("M6", "x", "out1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "x", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # inverter 1 (minimum size, small load on x)
    n.M("MI1N", "y", "x", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 0.15)
    n.M("MI1P", "y", "x", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.84, 0.15)
    # inverter 2 drives CL: x HIGH -> y LOW -> vout HIGH
    wn = p["Wn_out"]
    n.M("MI2N", "vout", "y", "vss", "vss", "nfet", wn, 0.15)
    n.M("MI2P", "vout", "y", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2.5 * wn, 0.15)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    power = vdd * (iref + I1 + I2)
    gm1 = m1.gm
    r1 = 1.0 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A1 = gm1 * r1
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    c1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + 1e-15
    cinv1 = 1.26 * 0.15 * 1e-14 + 1.5e-15
    cx = m6.cdd + m7.cdd + cinv1 + 1e-15
    dv1 = min(0.9, 2 * 0.9 / A2 + 0.15)
    i1_avail = min(I1, gm1 * vod * 2)
    t1 = c1 * dv1 / max(i1_avail, 1e-9)
    t2 = cx * 0.9 / I2
    cinv2 = 3.5 * wn * 0.15 * 1e-14 + 3e-15
    i_drive = 300e-6 * (wn / 1.5)
    t3 = 30e-12 + (cl + cinv2) * 0.9 / i_drive
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3

    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "offset": 0.9 / (A1 * A2) + 1e-3,
               "polarity_ok": 1, "gain_db": db(A1 * A2)}
